question: Kamal travels from City A to City B. If Kamal drives his car at (1)/(4) of his normal speed, then he reaches City B 54 minutes late. Find the time (in minutes) that Kamal would have taken to travel from City A to City B if he drove at his normal speed.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed ratio (Normal : New) = 4 : 1

Time ratio (Normal : New) = 1 : 4 (since distance is constant, time is inversely proportional to speed)

Difference in time ratio parts = 4 − 1 = 3 parts

Given delay is 54 minutes ⇒ 3 parts = 54 minutes

Normal time (1 part) = 54 ÷ 3 = 18 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 18 minutes.**
